mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 55 degree weather with overcast skies surrounding the Verona Public Library.
The City of Verona Water Utility is partnering with HydroCorp to perform cross-connection inspections to keep our water supply safe, so keep an eye on your mail for an appointment request letter.
There is plenty to do around town, including the Dane County Farmers Market today, along with live music performances at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Looking at the weekly report, on October 22, a vehicle crash occurred on West Verona Avenue near Todd Street involving a Metro Bus, resulting in a citation for failure to yield.
You can enjoy today's delicious flavor, Mint Explosion, at Culver's, which is currently open and serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight.
